_comment: People this wire always cares about.
A story naming anyone on this list is marked watched and sorts above
everything else, ahead of both the recognized-celebrity stories and the
plain ones. Within the watched group the newest still comes first.
A watched name also skips the fame threshold entirely: they get their
chip whatever Wikidata thinks of them. That is the point of the list -
it is the editorial override on a score that cannot know what this site
Matching ignores case and possessives, so "Aubrey Plaza's Broadway
debut" counts. Add a name exactly as it is normally printed.

watch.name: Aubrey Plaza
watch.note: Follow everything - stage work, casting, transfers.
